description: Change any part of the user's filmmaker profile: username, display name, bio, location, roles (up to 6, presets or custom), website, per-platform social links and whether the profile is public. Only the fields given change; the Profile page's validation, username rules and uniqueness check apply and its messages come back on failure. Avatar changes stay in the Profile page.

public.description: Whether the profile page is public (needs a valid username and a creator account).

roles.description: The complete list of roles (up to 6; presets like Director, Writer, Screenwriter or custom text). Replaces the current list.

social_links.description: Per-platform links; only the platforms given change, null removes one.

imdb.description: https link on imdb; null removes it.

instagram.description: https link on instagram; null removes it.

letterboxd.description: https link on letterboxd; null removes it.

tiktok.description: https link on tiktok; null removes it.

vimeo.description: https link on vimeo; null removes it.

x.description: https link on x; null removes it.

youtube.description: https link on youtube; null removes it.

username.description: New username (the public handle): lower-case letters, digits, dots and underscores; the Profile page's rules and uniqueness check apply.

name: update_filmmaker_profile
title: Update filmmaker profile
